versions.changelog:
Initial release of dbt-model-spec skill.

- Generates dbt model specs covering purpose, grain, lineage, transformation logic, columns, tests, and materialization.
- Emphasizes best practices: declare grain, use source()/ref(), define schema contract, and dbt tests.
- Produces skeleton SQL and YAML ready for implementation.
- Includes quality checks and anti-patterns to guide robust, reviewable model design.
- Designed for use when asked to design, plan, or test dbt models or transformations.
